STEP 1 - Scene: A salad bowl with mixed leafy greens (red/green lettuce, possibly spinach or mustard greens), thinly sliced green beans, shredded carrot, and red onion slices with a light dressing. Photographed from directly above, a top-down view.

STEP 2 - Ruler: A white square-ish bowl, roughly 20 cm across at its widest, so inner area about 3.14 x (10)^2 ≈ 314 cm^2 (treating it as a round-equivalent vessel).

STEP 3 - Items: mixed leafy greens (dominant), green beans (cut into thin strips, pooled at lower left), shredded carrot, red onion slices, light dressing sheen.

STEP 4 - Area: mixed leaves ~45% of vessel, green beans ~15%, carrot ~3%, red onion ~2%, dressing/sheen ~2%. Total food coverage ~ 60% of the vessel (about 188 cm^2).

STEP 5 - Volume: leafy greens 141 cm^2 x 3 cm ≈ 420 ml; green beans 47 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 70 ml; carrot and onion ≈ 10 ml combined.

STEP 6 - Grams: leafy greens 420 ml x 0.15 ≈ 63 g; green beans 70 ml x 0.6 ≈ 42 g; carrot and onion 10 ml x 0.6 ≈ 6 g; dressing ~5 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: mixed greens 63 g x 20 kcal/100 g ≈ 13 kcal; green beans 42 g x 31 kcal/100 g ≈ 13 kcal; carrot/onion 6 g x 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 2 kcal; dressing 5 g x 450 kcal/100 g ≈ 23 kcal (light oil-based dressing, a modest amount).

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A bowl about 60% covered with greens and beans, with light dressing, totals about 115 g and roughly 50 kcal. That is plausible for a small side salad with light dressing.

Estimated total: about 115 g, about 50 kcal.
